d: At Universal, we’re building the bridge between traditional finance and digital assets, with regulation and transparency at the foundation. Based in the UAE, we’re the issuer behind USDU, a US dollar stablecoin that institutions can trust. We’re regulated by the Financial Services Regulatory Authority (FSRA) in the Abu Dhabi Global Market (ADGM), and USDU is registered with the Central Bank of the UAE as a Foreign Payment Token.

What does that mean in practice? Every USDU token is backed 1:1 by real U.S. dollars held with regulated UAE banks, and our reserves are independently verified every month. We work alongside banks, exchanges, custodians and infrastructure partners to make faster, more transparent digital settlement possible. For us, trust isn’t a tagline. It’s built into everything we do.

We’re a growing team with an ambitious goal: powering a borderless economy. If you want to do meaningful work at the heart of the UAE’s digital finance story, and shape how it’s done responsibly, we’d love to meet you.

We are seeking an experienced and highly capable Senior Compliance Analyst to join the Compliance and AML function at Universal Digital in Abu Dhabi. As a regulated issuer, our credibility depends on the strength of our compliance framework. In this role, you will help ensure that Universal grows responsibly, with robust controls and a clear understanding of the regulatory landscape. You will bring deep knowledge of UAE AML/CFT requirements and hands-on experience across KYC/CDD, transaction monitoring, sanctions screening and SAR investigations.

Reporting to the Head of Compliance and MLRO, you will serve as a trusted advisor to the business, providing day-to-day compliance, AML and risk guidance and working directly with colleagues across departments. Your work will span compliance advisory, KYC/CDD, transaction monitoring, sanctions implementation, policy and procedure updates, and regulatory reporting across the firm’s business.

You will also help shape the systems and controls that protect our stablecoin ecosystem, from transaction monitoring rules and screening configurations to blockchain analytics tools. You will support our engagement with regulators, including the FSRA and the Central Bank of the UAE, and help us prepare for audits, inspections and thematic reviews.

The ideal candidate combines technical compliance expertise with a practical, business-minded approach. They are curious about digital assets and stablecoins, keep pace with regulatory change, and take pride in being a reliable partner to both leadership and the wider team. If you want to apply your compliance experience at the intersection of traditional regulation and digital finance, this role is for you.
